verses.text: 'Truly, truly, I say to you, he who does not enter by the door into the fold of the sheep, but climbs up some other way, he is a thief and a robber.
verses.textZh: 我實實在在的告訴你們，人進羊圈，不從門進去，倒從別處爬進去，那人就是賊，就是強盜。

verses.text: 'But he who enters by the door is a shepherd of the sheep.
verses.textZh: 從門進去的，才是羊的牧人。

verses.text: 'To him the doorkeeper opens, and the sheep hear his voice, and he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
verses.textZh: 看門的就給他開門；羊也聽他的聲音。他按著名叫自己的羊，把羊領出來。

verses.text: 'When he puts forth all his own, he goes ahead of them, and the sheep follow him because they know his voice.
verses.textZh: 既放出自己的羊來，就在前頭走，羊也跟著他，因為認得他的聲音。

verses.text: 'A stranger they simply will not follow, but will flee from him, because they do not know the voice of strangers.'
verses.textZh: 羊不跟著生人；因為不認得他的聲音。必要逃跑。

verses.text: This figure of speech Jesus spoke to them, but they did not understand what those things were which He had been saying to them.
verses.textZh: 耶穌將這比喻告訴他們，但他們不明白所說的是甚麼意思。

verses.text: So Jesus said to them again, 'Truly, truly, I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.
verses.textZh: 所以，耶穌又對他們說：我實實在在的告訴你們，我就是羊的門。

verses.text: 'All who came before Me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not hear them.
verses.textZh: 凡在我以先來的都是賊，是強盜；羊卻不聽他們。

verses.text: 'I am the door; if anyone enters through Me, he will be saved, and will go in and out and find pasture.
verses.textZh: 我就是門；凡從我進來的，必然得救，並且出入得草吃。

verses.text: 'The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I came that they may have life, and have [it] abundantly.
verses.textZh: 盜賊來，無非要偷竊，殺害，毀壞；我來了，是要叫羊（或作：人）得生命，並且得的更豐盛。

verses.text: 'I am the good shepherd; the good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
verses.textZh: 我是好牧人；好牧人為羊捨命。

verses.text: 'He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who is not the owner of the sheep, sees the wolf coming, and leaves the sheep and flees, and the wolf snatches them and scatters [them].
verses.textZh: 若是雇工，不是牧人，羊也不是他自己的，他看見狼來，就撇下羊逃走；狼抓住羊，趕散了羊群。

verses.text: '[He flees] because he is a hired hand and is not concerned about the sheep.
verses.textZh: 雇工逃走，因他是雇工，並不顧念羊。

verses.text: 'I am the good shepherd, and I know My own and My own know Me,
verses.textZh: 我是好牧人；我認識我的羊，我的羊也認識我，

verses.text: even as the Father knows Me and I know the Father; and I lay down My life for the sheep.
verses.textZh: 正如父認識我，我也認識父一樣；並且我為羊捨命。

verses.text: 'I have other sheep, which are not of this fold; I must bring them also, and they will hear My voice; and they will become one flock [with] one shepherd.
verses.textZh: 我另外有羊，不是這圈裡的；我必須領他們來，他們也要聽我的聲音，並且要合成一群，歸一個牧人了。

verses.text: 'For this reason the Father loves Me, because I lay down My life so that I may take it again.
verses.textZh: 我父愛我；因我將命捨去，好再取回來。

verses.text: 'No one has taken it away from Me, but I lay it down on My own initiative. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it up again. This commandment I received from My Father.'
verses.textZh: 沒有人奪我的命去，是我自己捨的。我有權柄捨了，也有權柄取回來。這是我從我父所受的命令。

verses.text: A division occurred again among the Jews because of these words.
verses.textZh: 猶太人為這些話又起了分爭。

verses.text: Many of them were saying, 'He has a demon and is insane. Why do you listen to Him?'
verses.textZh: 內中有好些人說：他是被鬼附著，而且瘋了，為甚麼聽他呢？

verses.text: Others were saying, 'These are not the sayings of one demon-possessed. A demon cannot open the eyes of the blind, can he?'
verses.textZh: 又有人說：這不是鬼附之人所說的話。鬼豈能叫瞎子的眼睛開了呢？

verses.text: At that time the Feast of the Dedication took place at Jerusalem;
verses.textZh: 在耶路撒冷有修殿節，是冬天的時候。

verses.text: it was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple in the portico of Solomon.
verses.textZh: 耶穌在殿裡所羅門的廊下行走。

verses.text: The Jews then gathered around Him, and were saying to Him, 'How long will You keep us in suspense? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly.'
verses.textZh: 猶太人圍著他，說：你叫我們猶疑不定到幾時呢？你若是基督，就明明的告訴我們。

verses.text: Jesus answered them, 'I told you, and you do not believe; the works that I do in My Father's name, these testify of Me.
verses.textZh: 耶穌回答說：我已經告訴你們，你們不信。我奉我父之名所行的事可以為我作見證；

verses.text: 'But you do not believe because you are not of My sheep.
verses.textZh: 只是你們不信，因為你們不是我的羊。

verses.text: 'My sheep hear My voice, and I know them, and they follow Me;
verses.textZh: 我的羊聽我的聲音，我也認識他們，他們也跟著我。

verses.text: and I give eternal life to them, and they will never perish; and no one will snatch them out of My hand.
verses.textZh: 我又賜給他們永生；他們永不滅亡，誰也不能從我手裡把他們奪去。

verses.text: 'My Father, who has given [them] to Me, is greater than all; and no one is able to snatch [them] out of the Father's hand.
verses.textZh: 我父把羊賜給我，他比萬有都大，誰也不能從我父手裡把他們奪去。

verses.text: 'I and the Father are one.'
verses.textZh: 我與父原為一。

verses.text: The Jews picked up stones again to stone Him.
verses.textZh: 猶太人又拿起石頭來要打他。

verses.text: Jesus answered them, 'I showed you many good works from the Father; for which of them are you stoning Me?'
verses.textZh: 耶穌對他們說：我從父顯出許多善事給你們看，你們是為那一件拿石頭打我呢？

verses.text: The Jews answered Him, 'For a good work we do not stone You, but for blasphemy; and because You, being a man, make Yourself out [to be] God.'
verses.textZh: 猶太人回答說：我們不是為善事拿石頭打你，是為你說僭妄的話；又為你是個人，反將自己當作神。

verses.text: Jesus answered them, 'Has it not been written in your Law, 'I SAID, YOU ARE GODS '?
verses.textZh: 耶穌說：你們的律法上豈不是寫著我曾說你們是神麼？

verses.text: 'If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture cannot be broken),
verses.textZh: 經上的話是不能廢的；若那些承受神道的人尚且稱為神，

verses.text: do you say of Him, whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, 'You are blaspheming,' because I said, 'I am the Son of God '?
verses.textZh: 父所分別為聖、又差到世間來的，他自稱是神的兒子，你們還向他說你說僭妄的話麼？

verses.text: 'If I do not do the works of My Father, do not believe Me;
verses.textZh: 我若不行我父的事，你們就不必信我；

verses.text: but if I do them, though you do not believe Me, believe the works, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in Me, and I in the Father.'
verses.textZh: 我若行了，你們縱然不信我，也當信這些事，叫你們又知道又明白父在我裡面，我也在父裡面。

verses.text: Therefore they were seeking again to seize Him, and He eluded their grasp.
verses.textZh: 他們又要拿他，他卻逃出他們的手走了。

verses.text: And He went away again beyond the Jordan to the place where John was first baptizing, and He was staying there.
verses.textZh: 耶穌又往約但河外去，到了約翰起初施洗的地方，就住在那裡。

verses.text: Many came to Him and were saying, 'While John performed no sign, yet everything John said about this man was true.'
verses.textZh: 有許多人來到他那裡。他們說：約翰一件神蹟沒有行過，但約翰指著這人所說的一切話都是真的。

verses.text: Many believed in Him there.
verses.textZh: 在那裡，信耶穌的人就多了。
